dedupe_keys.name: 2 5e andersson real time optimization of wind farms using modifier adaptation and machine learning

description: Leif Erik Andersson and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented optimiser uses Gaussian-process modifier adaptation to address mismatch between a wind-farm model and the controlled plant. It is demonstrated on a two-turbine test setting. The stated extension to larger farms remains prospective, and the record does not treat it as completed validation. The formulation supports operating-point optimisation under model error. The publication metadata do not establish a separately released code package, universal convergence or field-scale improvement across different turbine arrays. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
